# Vendored ICAL.js

- Package: [ical.js](https://www.npmjs.com/package/ical.js), version 2.2.1.
- Source: [upstream project](https://github.com/kewisch/ical.js).
- Artifact: unchanged `dist/ical.es5.cjs`, saved as `ical.js` for Apps Script upload.
- License: [MPL-2.0](ICAL-LICENSE), retained independently of the project MIT license.
- Package tarball integrity was verified against npm's SHA-512 integrity metadata.

The ES5 UMD build exposes the global `ICAL` in Apps Script and CommonJS exports
in Node tests. No runtime download, npm install, or remote code execution occurs.
